snippet.title: On Point - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at gameplay from On Point in this trailer for the retro shooter, filled with WarioWare-style arcade minigames. Think, aim, and blast your way to a high score through endless shooting minigames, but don't hit those bombs or you'll run out of lives! On Point is leaving Early Access, and Version 1.0 will be available in Q4 2025 on Steam and Meta.
